sloka: वज्र वैदूर्य गर्भाणि श्रवण अन्तेषु योषिताम् ।ददर्श तापनीयानि कुण्डलानि अन्गदानि च ॥५-१०-३३॥
transliteration: vajra vaidūrya garbhāṇi śravaṇa anteṣu yoṣitām ।dadarśa tāpanīyāni kuṇḍalāni angadāni ca ॥5-10-33॥

translations.english: He noticed on the earlobes of the the women gold earrings decked with diamonds and vaidurya. They were wearing shining armlets of gold.
